a low power embedded platform has been designed to detect distress calls and home automation commands by means of audio signals.
the proposed system can be used to provide tele assistance to people in the own home, and to control a home automation system.

the design and development of a complete system for monitoring the elderly at home.

the development of technologies that will enable the elderly people to live at home for as long as possible and in good conditions, while providing the possibility of monitoring the elderly and the house, and enabling a hands free interaction with the home automation system.
the design of a complete system for voice command and emergency recognition in home environments, which can be integrated in the home automation infrastructure.

the proposed system is suitable for monitoring the activities of elderly and disabled people and for providing hands free control of home automation devices.
the proposed solution can be considered a valid alternative to the existing ones, and that it can provide an effective support for the care givers and the elderly people.
the proposed solution can be considered as a complete and effective solution for monitoring people in their own home.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the system has been implemented on a low consuming embedded hardware platform and the algorithms have been tested on a realistic scenario with a good performance.
we have developed a complete solution for audio based emergency detection and home automation control.
the system is able to detect distress calls, to recognise home automation commands, to detect abnormal acoustic events and to communicate emergencies to a relative or care centre.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed solution can be used as a low-cost solution for home monitoring and tele assistance.

the combination of the two operation modes, namely the pro active mode based on novelty detection and the active mode based on voice commands and distress calls, allows to obtain a system able to detect a wide range of emergencies, including unknown events.

a single embedded platform can provide a comprehensive solution to the problem of elderly care in their own homes, combining the capability of recognising commands and detecting emergency sounds, thus enabling a pro-active approach to the elderly care.
